{{Top|leg}}
The '''Lan mining conglomerate''' was a mining conglomerate that operated in the ore-rich [[Lan system]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, through the machinations of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], the Empire acquired a majority stake in the conglomerate by convincing a number of shareholders to give up their shares.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Share and Share Alike}}</ref>
